text:
name: Agent Task
run-name: agent-task-${{ inputs.request_id }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      request_id:
        description: Task ID for init; operation ID for apply (32 hex)
        required: true
        type: string
      payload:
        description: Bounded JSON task request (init or apply)
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: agent-task
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  task:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout trusted helper
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Apply guarded operation
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 scripts/agent/run.py task
